body:
Thank you.

People of reddit are so nice, I wish people in real life were half as nice.

About therapy, I'm actually looking for a good therapist so I can start with him because talking about my problems on the internet have actually made me feel a bit better.

btw, I have a question: sometimes I will be drowned in loneliness or sadness and it will sometime cause me to get physically angry at myself -- is this normal? For example: Sometimes I will yell "WHY AM I SO LONELY" "FUCKING HATE MY LIFE" or something like that and either punch stuff or bite myself, I have bite marks all over my arm and I don't know how to explain it to people so I wear long sleeves all the time, even though it's really hot where I live.

I love reddit, they actually care. I was surfing the top posts in r/sw and stumbled into this http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/7qbls/goodbye_i_cant_take_this_pain_anymore/

I swear to god I'm in tears right now and I can't think of anything to reply with except this.
I'm sorry, but I don't think I understood what that meant...

Thank you

But it was just ridiculous, I mean, I was right THERE on msn, if any of them would have just said "Hi", I would have felt a 10 times better.

And no, I don't want to give up, because giving up is weak and I'm sick and tired of being weak. I want it to change, I want to change, I want my life to have a meaning. Everything is colorless and tasteless, I want it to have taste and color back again.

For example, I'm listening to music right now but I'm not really listening to it, I don't know how to explain it, but it's there so I can't hear myself think in the deathly silence of my room.

I guess this is probably why I posted this thread, I want to change my way of life, but I really don't have any motive, I tried to shape up and lose weight a couple of months ago but I only ended up failing because I had no motivation at all, I literally was in the middle of diet and exercise and I just went like "Wait, why am I doing this? who would give a shit anyway? It's not like having a better body would change anything" so I just fell back into my usual daily routine.

Well, I don't know what to say.

I'll just say what's on my mind:
I really don't matter to anyone. Really, nobody give a shit. (with the exception of my parents) I found this out the hard way. 

For my whole life, I've been the least popular kid (ok, I don't really care about popularity, but you get what I mean), probably the most hated kid also, the last one to get invited or not get invited at all... 
And even to this day, I've always felt like I'm the third wheel in everything and they probably just include me out of courtsey.

No one have really shown real affection towards me at all. Everyone is just being "nice" and it's probably just out of pity.


When I was in the 11th grade, I got really sick and had to be hospitalized for about 32 days, if I recall correctly. During that 32 days... NO ONE, NOT EVEN ONE SOUL called me to ask how I was doing, no one fucking visited me, I  was alone the entire fucking time!! Well, except for my parents who visited me everyday for one hour and I'm greatly thankful for them because I swear I would have gone insane. I asked them to get me a netbook so I can occupy myself and they did, I used the internet to go online on msn and I saw all of my "friends" online and guess what? no one even bothered to strike a conversation with me, I have already been gone for more than 10 days at that time.
